features: WHY IPAD PRO — iPad Pro with the Apple M5 chip delivers extraordinary performance for effortless productivity on a stunning display. Take on pro workflows with Neural Accelerators for AI and a redesigned iPadOS with game-changing capabilities.

PERFORMANCE AND STORAGE — iPad Pro with M5 brings next-generation speed and the power of on-device AI to all your tasks.* Featuring up to 2TB of storage, 16GB of unified memory and Neural Accelerators for next-level AI performance.

IPADOS — Run pro apps and get more done with iPadOS 26 with Liquid Glass design and game-changing capabilities. With an intuitive and flexible windowing system, you can control, organise and manage your workflows like never before.

APPLE INTELLIGENCE — Apple Intelligence is the personal intelligence system that helps you communicate, express yourself and get things done effortlessly with groundbreaking privacy protections at every step.

[28.22 cm (11′′) / 33.02 cm (13′′)] ULTRA RETINA XDR DISPLAY — The world’s most advanced display, featuring extreme brightness, precise contrast, ProMotion, P3 wide colour and True Tone. Nano-texture display glass is available in 1TB and 2TB configurations.
